project_extensions.scope: Research provenance, reproducibility, and independent physical checks

acceptance_criteria: Signed shifted D-dimensional loop and analytic PV agree below 1e-48 GeV² at both physical momenta and three matched scales.
Physical h_i+Z unitarity cut and dispersive second derivative independently reproduce the shifted loop for both masses.
Finite D times UV control, scale slope and signed A29 Z-only projection with all W inputs fixed pass.
Byte-identical replay, locked central adoption and RCRPS v1.0.1 checks pass.
